text: The purpose of this report is to propose the installation of a U-turn prohibition for westbound traffic on Rexdale Boulevard at Humberwood Boulevard. This proposed U-turn prohibition will help to reduce vehicle conflicts on Rexdale Boulevard. Motorists have been observed performing U-turns at the subject location from a lane designated for through traffic. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Rexdale Boulevard, City Council approval of this report is required.
City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit U-turn movements at all times for westbound traffic on Rexdale Boulevard at Humberwood Boulevard.
